question: Select all that apply: Which of these followed Pakistan's 3 December 1971 attack on India?

options.text: Full-scale conventional war between India and Pakistan opened
Bangladesh-India joint forces advanced across several fronts
Pakistani forces surrendered in Dhaka on 16 December
The National Assembly session was postponed
The Mujibnagar Government took its oath

explanation: After the 3 December attack, full-scale war opened, joint forces advanced on several fronts, and Pakistani forces surrendered on 16 December. The postponed Assembly session and the Mujibnagar oath came months earlier.
